title: Bulk Regulations for Residential Uses in M1-1D Through M1-5D Districts
previewText: In M1-1D through M1-5D Districts, where residential uses are permitted pursuant to Article IV, Chapter 2, the bulk regulations of a C2 District mapped within an R5 District shall apply.
